hypotheses.hypothesis: Taker net outflows, weekly spot outflows, futures/spot volume near 4.4x and a recent ETF outflow are consistent with a spot-demand weakness scenario.
hypotheses.counter_hypothesis: Tracked exchange balances declined on a same-wallet basis; Binance perpetual near-book showed a modest bid skew; negative funding may support a short-covering rebound.
disconfirming_evidence: Sustained positive net taker flow across multiple spot venues.
Rising spot volume and depth with lower futures/spot ratio.
Issuer-complete ETF inflows and stable exchange-wallet coverage.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Negative funding and long-heavy liquidations suggest positioning stress and potential liquidation sensitivity.
hypotheses.counter_hypothesis: CoinGlass and Liqwall OI aggregates disagree by about 2x; CoinGlass shows slightly higher OI while Liqwall shows falling OI; provider universes are not reconciled.
disconfirming_evidence: Synchronized exchange-level OI, funding and liquidation payloads with reconciled contract coverage.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Ripple's BNY, Coinbase, Robinhood, C2FO and SBI relationships expand distribution, custody, treasury and RLUSD settlement infrastructure.
hypotheses.counter_hypothesis: Several capabilities are future/planned; SBI VCTRADE supports RLUSD only on Ethereum; Coinbase collateral support was announced as future; C2FO has a waitlist; no XRPL or XRP volume is disclosed.
disconfirming_evidence: Audited or independently verified XRPL settlement volume, native XRP bridge use, collateral balances and counterparty-level flows.

notes: CoinGlass, Liqwall, Basis and XRP Insights are not a common synchronized feed; do not average their prices, OI or depth.
The 22.24B exchange balance figure includes cold storage and public label attribution; it is not liquid sell-side depth.
SBI VC Trade's RLUSD listing is Ethereum-only, not XRPL.
Coinbase Global Exchange RLUSD collateral support was announced as future, not live at launch.
The $520B C2FO Early Pay figure is historical program working capital, not XRPL volume or committed capital.
Ripple's reported $16T product transaction enablement is company-wide product volume, not XRP Ledger settlement volume.
No raw publisher response bytes were archived in this run.
